sourceName: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) Mineral Commodity Summaries 2024 & 2025
datasetName: Global Manganese Ore Reserves, World Mine Production & Country Profiles
description: Authoritative global mineral dataset providing country-by-country manganese ore reserves, annual contained metal production, reserve-to-production ratios, and historical global supply trends (South Africa, Australia, Gabon, China, Brazil, India, Ukraine, Ghana).
license: USGS Open Data / United States Public Domain

sourceName: International Manganese Institute (IMnI) & World Steel Association
datasetName: Global Manganese Trade Flows, CIF Benchmark Pricing & Seaborne Supply
description: International manganese industry statistics covering seaborne trade flows (South Africa, Gabon, Australia exports to China, India, EU), CIF Tianjin benchmark price trends ($/dmtu), and blast furnace alloy demand.

sourceName: International Seabed Authority (ISA) & Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES) India
datasetName: Deep-Sea Polymetallic Manganese Nodules (CIOB & CCZ Marine Zones)
description: Deep ocean mineral survey data of Central Indian Ocean Basin (CIOB) 75,000 sq km exploration area and Clarion-Clipperton Zone (CCZ) polymetallic nodule deposits containing high-grade manganese, nickel, cobalt, and copper.
license: International Seabed Authority & MoES Deep Ocean Mission Disclosures

datasetName: Annual Production, Sales, Financials & Mine Operational Status
description: Statutory audited annual operational figures including historical ore production (13.02L tonnes in FY23, 17.56L in FY24, 18.02L in FY25, 19.07L in FY26), domestic sales, ferro-manganese plant output, and operational mine leases.
license: Government Public Sector Undertaking Public Disclosures (MOIL Limited, Ministry of Steel)

sourceName: MOIL Limited Investor Presentations & Press Releases (PIB)
datasetName: Quarterly Production Milestones & Production Growth Targets
description: Official corporate investor disclosures and Press Information Bureau (PIB) press releases detailing monthly extraction milestones, Capex allocations, and Vision 2030 target of 3.5 Million Tonnes per annum.
license: Ministry of Steel / PIB Govt. of India Public Domain

sourceName: Indian Bureau of Mines (IBM) National Mineral Inventory & Indian Minerals Yearbook
datasetName: National Manganese Ore Reserves & Resource Classification (UNFC)
description: Official UNFC reserve/resource classifications establishing total MOIL manganese ore reserves and resources at 121.97 Million Tonnes (53.47 Mt Reserves + 68.50 Mt Remaining Resources).
license: Indian Bureau of Mines, Ministry of Mines Open Data

sourceName: ESA Copernicus Sentinel-2 MSI Multi-Spectral Earth Observation
datasetName: Multi-Spectral Vegetation Index (NDVI) & Surface Clearing Telemetry
description: Public Earth Observation satellite data (Bands 4 & 8) mapped over Central India mining coordinates (Balaghat MP, Nagpur/Bhandara MH) for vegetative baseline tracking and slope disturbance.
license: Copernicus Open Access Hub / ESA Open Science Policy

sourceName: NASA Earthdata MODIS (Terra/Aqua) & GPM Precipitation IMERG
datasetName: Soil Moisture Index, Precipitation Rate & Land Surface Temperature
description: Satellite microwave radiometric soil moisture and 0.1° GPM precipitation rates over the Balaghat, Bhandara, and Nagpur mining districts as proxies for open-bench moisture saturation and pit wall slide risk.
license: NASA Earth Science Data Systems Open Data

sourceName: India Meteorological Department (IMD) Gridded Rainfall Data
datasetName: Historical Precipitation & Monsoonal Seasonality in Balaghat/Vidarbha
description: District-level meteorological precipitation (mm) and temperature recordings for Balaghat (MP), Bhandara (MH), and Nagpur (MH) mining zones.
license: Ministry of Earth Sciences, Govt. of India Public Disclosures

sourceName: MOIL ReserveIQ Synthetic Geological Simulation Engine
datasetName: Simulated Diamond Core Drilling Assay Logs
description: Synthetic borehole core assays (collar elevations, core recovery %, RQD %, Mn/Fe/SiO2 grades) calibrated to regional Mansar/Chorbaoli geological formations for demonstration of AI reserve estimation.
license: Demonstration Only — Not Official MOIL Core Samples

datasetName: Simulated Heavy Earth Moving Machinery (HEMM) SCADA Logs
description: Synthetic machine health indicators, Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF), and hourly downtime causes representing typical opencast and underground equipment fleets.
license: Demonstration Only — Not Proprietary MOIL Telemetry
